name: form-validation
description: Create a form with comprehensive validation

variants.typescript: Write a TypeScript FormValidator class that validates form data against rules. Include interfaces for validation rules and results.
variants.javascript: Write a JavaScript FormValidator class that validates form data against rules.
variants.javascript-jsdoc: Write a JavaScript FormValidator class with JSDoc that validates form data against rules.
variants.javascript-vanilla-web:
Create a registration form with client-side validation in vanilla JavaScript. Include:

**Form Fields:**
- Username (required, 3-20 chars, alphanumeric)
- Email (required, valid email format)
- Password (required, min 8 chars, 1 uppercase, 1 number)
- Confirm Password (required, must match password)
- Age (required, 18-120)
- Terms checkbox (required)

**Validation:**
- Real-time validation on blur
- Show error messages below each field
- Disable submit button until form is valid
- Show all errors on submit attempt
- Visual indicators (red border for errors, green for valid)

**HTML:**
- Semantic form structure
- Label for each input
- Error message containers
- Submit button

**CSS:**
- Clean form design
- Error styling (red)
- Success styling (green)
- Focus states

**JavaScript:**
- Validation functions for each field type
- Real-time validation handlers
- Form submission handler
- Display/clear error messages

Return as single HTML file with working validation.
variants.javascript-vanilla-web-jsdoc:
Same as javascript-vanilla-web, plus complete JSDoc:

- @typedef for ValidationRule
- @typedef for ValidationResult
- @typedef for FormField
- Document all validation functions
- @param and @return for all functions

Return as single HTML file.
variants.typescript-vanilla-web:
Create a form validation system using TypeScript and vanilla Web APIs. Include:

**TypeScript:**
- Interface for ValidationRule<T>
- Interface for FieldConfig
- Type-safe validator functions
- Generic FormValidator<T> class
- Proper typing for form data

**Validation Rules:**
- Required
- MinLength/MaxLength
- Pattern (regex)
- Custom validators
- Async validators (e.g., check username availability)

**Features:**
- Real-time validation
- Field-level and form-level validation
- Error message handling
- Type-safe form data

Provide TypeScript source and HTML structure.
variants.typescript-react:
Create a form with validation using TypeScript React. Include:

**Components:**
- Form (main container)
- FormField (reusable field with validation)
- FormError (error display)

**Custom Hook:**
- useForm<T> hook with TypeScript
- Generic form state management
- Validation logic
- Submit handling

**TypeScript:**
- Interface for form data
- Type-safe validation rules
- Proper hook typing
- Generic FormField component

**Features:**
- Real-time validation
- Touched/dirty state tracking
- Custom validation rules
- Async validation support
- TypeScript strict mode

**Example:**
```tsx
interface FormData {
  username: string;
  email: string;
  password: string;
}

const { values, errors, handleChange, handleSubmit } = useForm<FormData>({
  initialValues: { username: '', email: '', password: '' },
  validationRules: { ... }
});
```

No form libraries (e.g., no Formik, react-hook-form). Build from scratch.
